path.intro: Treat this opening like a short learning path. Complete one line at a time; NexoChess keeps your progress and points you to the next useful step.
path.title: Course path

practice.autoRule: When you learn a line, NexoChess adds it to your personal repertoire automatically.
practice.againCoach: Good. Play it once more from the start so the sequence sticks.
practice.studyHint: Follow the line once, then reproduce it from memory.
practice.extra: Because you needed a hint or missed a move, this lesson gets one extra repetition.
practice.repeatRule: A new line is repeated twice immediately before it is considered learned.
practice.completeBody: You have reinforced it now. It will come back later only when the spaced-repetition schedule says reviewing it is useful.
practice.autoSaved: Added automatically to your personal repertoire.
practice.srsExplainer: You do not need to replay every learned line whenever you open Repertoire. Only reviews that are due return here.

profile.title: Build a course around the openings you actually play
profile.intro: Optionally enter a public Chess.com or Lichess username. NexoChess looks at recent games, estimates which opening families appear most often and suggests where to start studying.
profile.error: NexoChess could not read recent public games for that account right now. Check the username or try the other platform later.
profile.heuristic: This is an opening-study heuristic based on frequency, results and how far the catalogue recognises the line; it is not an engine verdict on individual moves.
profile.recommendation: With {{side}}, this appeared in {{games}} games, scored {{score}}, and the recognised opening sequence averaged about {{moves}} moves. Studying it is likely to affect many of your games.
profile.noData: Not enough recognised games on this side yet.
